description: Check a set of 2 to 20 products (e.g. a shower enclosure and a tray) before recommending them together. Returns a verdict for every pair (a, b = product IDs, a_sku, b_sku = the evaluated variants): fits, fits_after_cut (the cuttable tray is cut to size), incompatible, unknown (data missing, not a match) or not_applicable (we do not track compatibility for that pair), with a reason code and a message in the shop language.

ids.description: 2 to 20 product IDs (Shoptet GUID) or variant SKUs.
